name: Flying Flame
text:
A Tiny shape of flame appears, taking a form of your choice—such as a bird, an arrow, or a simple sphere. It Flies from you up to 30 feet in a path you choose. Each creature it passes through takes floor((@actor.level -1/2)+1)d6 fire damage with a basic Reflex save save against your class DC. A creature attempts only one save, even if the flame passes through it multiple times.

---

Level (+2) The damage increases by 1d6.
